name: What is the difference between a commercial build-out and a new construction?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a commercial build-out and a new construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: A commercial build-out involves customizing an existing interior space within an already constructed building, often transforming a shell space or an older unit into a new business environment. New construction, conversely, refers to building a structure from the ground up on previously undeveloped land or after demolishing an old structure. Build-outs are generally less extensive and have shorter timelines than new construction, focusing on interior modifications rather than foundational or exterior structural development.
acceptedAnswer.description: A build-out customizes an existing interior, while new construction builds a structure from the ground up.
